gcm.purpose: Release Client Health v2.2 with deduplicated, recency-weighted, explainable evidence scoring.
changeNotes: Deduplicates durable evidence by source reference before scoring.
Business Performance requires measured or asserted actual outcomes and rejects hypothetical/expected impact.
Generic website mentions no longer inflate Website / Conversion.
Risk scoring uses active-risk and negative evidence instead of generic priority labels.
Client-safe summaries remove generic monitoring placeholders and weak priority-only text.
